messages.subject: disable inputs based on another input
parts:
I would like to have users choose a number of assessments. Based on that number they will then be able to choose correlations for those assessments.  If the user chooses only 2 assessments then they should only be allowed to choose 1 correlation, or 3 assessments then 4 correlations.    How do I fix the code below depend on this???

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- fluidPage(theme = shinythemes::shinytheme("superhero"),
  
   
   # Application title
   titlePanel("Shrinkage Factor"),
   
   # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins 
   sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
         sliderInput("assessments",
                     "Choose a number of assessments",
                     min = 2,
                     max = 4,
                     value = 4),
         
         #numeric input dropdown options
         numericInput(inputId="r1",label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 1 and 2",
                      min=-1, max=1,step=.01, value=0),
         numericInput(inputId="r2",label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 2 and 3",
                      min=-1, max=1, step=.01, value=0),
         numericInput(inputId="r3", label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 1 and 3",
                      min=-1, max=1, step=.01, value=0),
          numericInput(inputId="r4", label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 1 and 4",
                      min=-1, max=1, step=.01, value=0),
         numericInput(inputId="r5", label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 2 and 4",
                      min=-1, max=1, step=.01, value=0),
         numericInput(inputId="r6", label="Choose a correlation value for the assessments 3 and 4",
                      min=-1, max=1, step=.01, value=0)
         #actionButton("calculate", "Calculate")
      ),
      
      mainPanel(
         verbatimTextOutput("summary"),
         sliderInput("cutoff", "Current cutoff score", 
                     min=0,
                     max=.99,
                     value=.90),
         plotOutput("cut")
      )
   )
   )


# Define server logic required 
server <- function(input, output) {
  sd.mean <- function(assessments, corr) {
    if (length(corr) == choose(assessments, 2)) {
      return(sqrt((1/assessments) + ((2*(1/assessments)^2)*sum(corr))))}  else {
      print("Wrong number of correlations provided given the number of assessments.")}
  }
  
  # doCalc <- eventReactive(input$calculate, {
  # #  output$summary <- renderPrint({
  #     assessments <- input$assessments
  #  }, ignoreNULL=FALSE)
  
  output$summary <- renderPrint({
    shrinkage <- sd.mean(input$assessments, corr=c(input$r1, input$r2, input$r3, 
                                                   input$r4, input$r5, input$r6))
    print(shrinkage)
    print(paste("The cutoff z-score is ", round(qnorm(.9, 0, shrinkage),2), sep=""))
  })
  validate(
    need(input$assessment)
  )
  
  output$cut <- renderPlot({
    x <-seq(-3,3)
    y1 <- dnorm(x, 0, input$cutoff)
    y2 <- dnorm(x, 0, shrinkage)
    data <-data.frame(cbind
                      (rep(x,2),
                        c(y1,y2),
                        c(rep(1, length(x)),rep(2,length(x)))))
    names(data) <- c("x","y", "group")
    ggplot(data=data, aes(x=x,y=y, col=factor(group))) + geom_line() + 
      scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1") + ggtitle("Cutoff scores") +
      theme_grey()
  })
  
  }

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
